optimizedDescription.value: Defines workflow instruction, shell, and external hooks; effect binding dispatch, ordering, failure policy, skip controls, and escaping.

optimizedContext.value:
# Hook Execution Model

## Rules
- Entry: `id` + exactly one `instruction:`, `run:`, or `external: { type, config }`; invalid shape → `SchemaValidationError`. Every step/phase may use all forms.
- `instruction:` passive text only: `GetHookInstructions(step, phase, hookId?)`; never process, predicate/effect, or `CompileContext`. `run:` shell-only `HookRunner`, never agent context. External dispatches runner supporting `external.type`; absent runner fails clearly.
- Effects selected by binding matchers (`from`/`to`/`along`), phase, `onFailure`; never check ID/private source-post path. `TransitionChange`: matching `hook.pre` and `hook.post` both `before-persist`, `abort`. `ArchiveChange`: pre `before-persist`/abort, post `after-persist`/collect. `Change` executes nothing.
- `RunStepHooks` standalone: pre fail-fast; post continue/collect; CLI exits 2 on failures. Effects with `abort` throw `HookFailedError`; pre-persist failure leaves no state/files mutation. Collect failure records and continues after persisted archive.
- Order per pre/post: schema declaration order, then matching project `schemaOverrides` order.
- `skipHookPhases`: transition `source.pre|source.post|target.pre|target.post|all`; archive `pre|post|all`; skips effects, never predicates. Transition pre/post share binding phase, so selector determines skip. Manual sequence: `specd change hook-instruction`, `specd change run-hooks`, lifecycle `--skip-hooks`, post `run-hooks`, post instruction; preserve `along` filter.
- `HookRunner` expands/shell-escapes `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.path}}`, `{{project.root}}`; unknown token unchanged. No `{{change.workspace}}`; derive plural workspaces from `specIds`.

## Constraints
- `RunStepHooks` sole execution engine for hook checks/CLI.
- Transition source.post: forward-only, before-persist, abort; archive post: after-persist, collect.
- Binding phase/`onFailure` controls timing/policy; callers never expand variables.
